newsitem.title: USA: Heartland Comms names Foudy CEO, chairman, pres.
newsitem.headline: Heartland Comms names Foudy CEO, chairman, pres.

text.p: Heartland Communications & Management Inc, which is planning a public offering of stock, said on Thursday its board had named Michael L. Foudy chairman, president and chief executive.
The company said Foudy will replace Gerald Garcia, who resigned Aug 19 to pursue another opportunity.
The board expressed its regrets at the loss of Garcia, but said it was confident that all projects under development should go forward as planned.
The board confirmed its intent to proceed with a $20 million public offering, filed July 26 with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Foudy is one of the firm's principal founders and had recruited Garcia for his skills in project conception.
The company develops and syndicates radio programming and newspaper supplements.
